text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Some time has passed since the
announcement of
the URA Finale.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
The Finale Champion, huh? Now you're
talkin'!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I wonder which race I should go for...

Medium-distance? Or maybe even the
mile?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
You'd better make it the mile... for your
own
good.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'm going for the medium-distance race,
and I'm
always number one! ♪

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: What?! Them's fightin' words!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
That settles it! I'm goin' for medium too!
Let's
settle this once and for all, Scarlet!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hmph! Bring it on!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohohoho! The first champion of the
URA
Finale... Truly, a title worthy of a
first-rate racer
such as I, King Halo!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Come, Sky! I shall grant you the honor of
racing
with me! Join me for another
round of partner
running!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, I'm coming... Boy, you sure
are good
at bossing people around.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Although... I guess this is my chance to
check a
few things, so... whatever.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Excitement is spreading among the
Umamusume
as they prepare for the
URA Finale.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As I renew my resolve...
choice_data_list: (I have to do my best too...!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: VRRROOOOM!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I dash off in the direction of the noise to
see
what's going on.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Who... Where... Why...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: What is this huge machine?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I arrive at the dirt track to find Tazuna in
a
panic...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: VRRROOOOM!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...and what appears to be an enormous
vehicle
producing an explosive noise.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Hahahaha! Crying out for joy, Tazuna? I

completely understand!
choice_data_list: What on earth is going on here...?

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Oho?

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Serendipity! Why, if it isn't

Trainer <username>!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Fortuitous! You're just the person I
wanted to talk
to. With regards to—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Now wait just a moment, Director!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Before you go any further, please
explain this
enormous contraption!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Apologies! I've gotten ahead of myself.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Heh, heh, heh. Listen and be amazed!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Restoration! Dirt tracks just like new in
an instant!
Adjustments! Fine-tune the
amount of sand
needed to your exact
specifications!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Behold! The pinnacle of racecourse
maintenance
technology... the
Ready-Paver Mk. III!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The pinnacle of racecourse maintenance

technology? Don't tell me you dipped
into your
pocket money again!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Naturally! When it comes to providing a
safe
training environment for our
precious
Umamusume, I will spare no
expense!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Any price I pay towards such a goal is
trivial!
Trivial, I say!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That's a wonderful sentiment, but can't
you ever
do things in moderation?!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear... Where are we even going to
put
something this enormous?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: VRRROOOOM!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry you had to see this, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Apologies! And may I say...

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Greetings! It's been far too long,
Trainer
<username>!
Why, I
believe the last time we spoke was
during
your training days!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Oho? What's this? That gleam in your
eyes... Now
that's a look I can get
behind!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Vindication! I knew you were someone to
keep an
eye on!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Vindication! I knew you were someone to
keep an
eye on!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Director Akikawa has had her eye
on you
for some time.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! Since the time my mother was
director of
the academy, I have seen
many trainers come
through these gates.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Thusly! By the way you carry yourself
and how you
interact with your trainee, I
can tell...

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Conviction! As a trainer, you will become
a firm
pillar to support your
Umamusume's dreams!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I feel the same. Which is why we've
wanted to
speak with you for some
time...

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! We would love for you and your
trainee
to help us make the URA Finale
a success!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, everything rests on the
presence of
those who bear the hopes
and dreams of their
fans on their
shoulders...

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
That is to say, if the race is to succeed,
we must
have star Umamusume take
part.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The best and only way to win fans is to

participate in races.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
But if you can amass a great number of
victories
and gather enough support...

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Success! The path to becoming a star

Umamusume will open before you!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Encouragement! Keep pushing forward
together
with your trainee!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
We're looking forward to seeing her
sprint
towards becoming the first Finale
Champion!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Director Akikawa's passion renews my
excitement
for the URA Finale.
